_about: Declarative Cloudflare DNS config for ContextualWisdomLab. Reconciled by .github/workflows/cloudflare-dns.yml (curl + jq, idempotent). The Cloudflare account id and API token are supplied at runtime from org GitHub Secrets CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID / CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN. NOTHING secret lives in this file.

_record_schema.record_type: A | AAAA | CNAME | TXT | MX | ... (Cloudflare DNS record type)
_record_schema.record_name: FQDN or @ for the zone apex (e.g. 'keyverse.io' or 'www.keyverse.io')
_record_schema.record_proxied: true|false — orange-cloud proxy; use true for Pages custom domains fronted by CF
_record_schema.record_ttl: 1 for automatic, or seconds; ignored when record_proxied is true

_records_note: Records are intentionally empty for now: the Pages hosting targets do not exist yet. Once a Cloudflare Pages project is created for a product, add its custom-domain records here (usually a CNAME from the apex/www to <project>.pages.dev, proxied=true) and re-run the workflow in apply mode.
